statements.t: Over this time, we have built upon our original core competency of laboratory animal medicine and science (research model technologies) to develop a diverse portfolio of discovery and safety assessment services, both Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and non-GLP, that supports our clients from target identification through non-clinical development.

Through the ongoing actions, the Company expects to achieve approximately $300 million of cumulative annualized cost savings by the end of 2026, with more than $175 million realized through fiscal 2025.

Additionally, we may be required to fund up to $45.0 million of future EBITDA losses and capital expenditures of the divested businesses over a four-year period, which is expected to be fully used by GI.

estimates.t: Our discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations is based upon our consolidated financial statements prepared in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles in the U.S.

statements.t: • Organic revenue growth of 4.7%, outperforming the Company's prior outlook and representing a return to organic revenue growth for the second consecutive quarter.
